mapper.select: SELECT e.*, m.name AS meeting_name, u.real_name AS referee_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_registration r WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0) AS current_participants FROM t_event e LEFT JOIN t_meeting m ON e.meeting_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ssms_auth.t_user u ON e.referee_id = u.id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0
